Hop on the new scooter and zip around your farm faster than ever!
Explore two brand-new areas in Countryside! Help sea turtles at Turtle Beach: clear away litter, care for turtles, guide hatchlings to the sea, and craft beautiful jewelry from turtle shells. Befriend wise, gentle elephants at the Tea Farm and learn the art of tea-making, from growing and drying leaves to packaging the finished tea.
